I'm Chris. Chances are pretty good that I'm probably up to something. I'm a self taught electronics enthusiast who managed to turn my hobbies into a career as an electrical/FPGA engineer. A brief brush with high-energy physics, TCAD simulations of wide-bandgap semiconductors, and some inhuman soldering skills means that I'm never afraid to get my hands dirty

I try to embody the "mess around and find out" mentality which often manifests as wild flailing punctuated by strokes of cleverness. You'll always be able to find me working on some gizmo, widget, or gadget.
